|[[File:Rogue 19.gif|80px]][[File:Rogue 19 alt.gif|80px]][[File:Rogue 19 starter.png|80px]]
|'''Gemini - $3.99'''
*Part of the '''Call of Stars''' skinline.
*Has a reskin '''Jack and Mary''' called '''Verity & Fallacy'''.
*Has 2 forms where the initial form will switch to the alt form for 15 seconds after 8 kills.
*Has unique skill effect for each skill.
*Has visual art & card.
*Has unique portrait.
*Has unique entrance effect.
|
*First skin in the game to cost $3.99.
*Based on the Gemini constellation.
*Has 8 marks orbiting him, starting with all of them colored blue. A blue mark turns red for each enemy killed.
**Once all 8 marks turn red, he will switch to his alt form and the skill effects' color scheme will change from blue to red. Alt form lasts for approximately 15 seconds, indicated by the red marks slowly turning back to blue, one by one. Once all the marks turn blue, he will revert back to his initial form.
